How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Panjab University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 02-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Panjab University Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Panjab University Guest Faculty recruitment is 02-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Guest Faculty post in Panjab University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification is a Master’s degree in Microbiology/Biotechnology/Microbial Biotechnology or an allied subject with at least 55% marks.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs.1500/- per lecture, with an upper limit of Rs.50000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending their application via email to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty role?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is a Ph.D. degree mandatory for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. degree is desirable but not mandatory. Clearing NET/SLET/SET or having a Ph.D. as per UGC regulations is required.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Guest Faculty position is contract-based.
